  APPEND_ITEM Ref_wasmSeq_ControllerState 8 UINT "Current executing state of the sequencer controller"
    STATE __FPRIME_UNINITIALIZED 0
    STATE IDLE 1
    STATE INVOKING 2
    STATE LOADING_TO_READY 3
    STATE LOADING_TO_RUN 4
    STATE LOAD_RUNNING_START 5
    STATE READY 6
    STATE RUNNING_MAIN 7
    STATE RUNNING_START_PENDING_MAIN 8

    STATE __FPRIME_UNINITIALIZED 0
    STATE IDLE 1
    STATE RUNNING_AWAITING_RESPONSE_SLEEPING 2
    STATE RUNNING_AWAITING_RESPONSE_WAITING 3
    STATE RUNNING_PAUSED 4
    STATE RUNNING_SPINNING 5
